sentences.text: Heard Mr. ATM Hussain, learned counsel for the petitioner.
The petitioner has approached this court by filing the instant writ petition being aggrieved by land acquisition compensation decided by CALA under the National Highway Act, 1956.
During pendency of the writ petition, the petitioner has approached the Page No.# 3/3 Arbitrator appointed by the Central Government and made a claim in terms of Section 3(G) of the Act, 1956.
That being the position, the present writ petition stands closed.
